emma (ML Eng): Shadow run summary: compared quant-keystone-int4 (new int4 build) vs baseline v2. Long-context doc workload, 25k samples. Observed small overall MRR drop and a pronounced hit on a reference-heavy slice + p99 latency tail increase. Also saw slight uptick in citation hallucination. Posting quick numbers.

raj (Infra): Can you share per-slice counts and CI? Any config diffs (kv warmup, batching, async prefetch)?

emma (ML Eng): Quick stats (aggregate):
```
total_requests: 25312
overall_mrr_delta: -0.009   # -0.9%
ref_slice_requests: 2420
ref_slice_mrr_delta: -0.038  # -3.8%
p95_latency_delta: +45ms
p99_latency_delta: +200ms
hallucination_rate_delta: +0.003  # +0.3% absolute on citation tests
```
KV warmup toggled off earlier for debug but main shadow run had KV warmup ON. We did bump batch target to 32 on quant lanes to increase throughput.

liam (Research): Hmm. batch_target=32 could explain p99 tail + token padding interactions. Any difference in tokenization or max_seq? Are examples in ref_slice longer on avg?

emma (ML Eng): ref_slice avg tokens ~1.8k vs overall 600. Tokenization same. Example failure snippets (manual review):
- "cite: [1] This paper shows..." -> model fabricates authors/urls where baseline cites correctly.
- truncation miscases around long prefix leading to hallucinated summaries.

maya (ProdAnalyst): Proposed gating rules for canary/promote:
- Block promotion if any slice MRR drop > 1.5% absolute
- Block if p99 latency increase > 150ms
- Block if hallucination_rate increase > 0.5% absolute
- Canary run: start at 5% traffic for 1 hour; require no blocked signals for 60m
Auto-fallback: if production rolling(5m) breaches any of above thresholds, rollback to previous variant immediately.

raj (Infra): I can config the rollout. Plan: send 5% traffic to quant-keystone for 60m, sample logs for ref_slice and citation labels. If any single slice breach triggers, route weight -> 0 and send alert to #incidents.

deploy-bot: /deploy canary quant-keystone-int4 --weight=5 --duration=60m
Note: Auto-fallback hook enabled. Will emit webhook on threshold breach.

emma (ML Eng): Action items: I'll re-run shadow with batch_target=16 and explicit KV prefetch to see if p99 improves. Also expand reference slice with 3x more examples (to reduce CI). Will post updated numbers in this thread.

liam (Research): Also try enabling sequential prefetch (warm up top-k) to reduce cold KV misses. If that helps, we can keep batch=32 but add prefetch.

maya (ProdAnalyst): I'll create a dashboard tile for the ref_slice and set alert thresholds per above. Will also attach an eval job that runs hourly during canary.

emma (ML Eng): Thanks all. I'll kick the retest in ~30m and post results. :thumbsup:

raj (Infra): solid. keep us posted @maya for alerts and @deploy-bot for scheduling.

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled. Monitoring hooks: latency/p99, mrr_delta, hallucination_rate. Auto-fallback enabled.
